notes.title: Small Patch: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the wording on the customization label in the level select menu.
[*] Changed the wording on the unlocks panel in the level select menu.
[*] Added a field that displays to players that they can unlock ship customization after reaching level 2.
[*] Added a field that displays to players that they can unlock the Rogue-like game mode after reaching level 5.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day is here!
notes.content:
The time has finally come. Take to the skies and escape the approaching threat to save your colony.

Empyrean Swarm is now live!

Join the Discord for updates and a more direct line to the developer [url=https://discord.gg/txfxTTneRN]here[/url].

If you enjoy the music of Empyrean Swarm, keep an eye out. The soundtrack will be coming soon!

notes.title: Bugfix 2/15/2024
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where the player high heat and overheat sound would play while adapting.

notes.title: Prep for Launch
notes.content:
It's official! We have a launch date and it's VERY SOON: 2/20/2024.

Feel free to join us on during the Steam next fest in February to get a glimpse of the game and see if you like it. Otherwise, you can take to your fighters and try it yourself in just a few short weeks!

Thanks again to everyone who helped us get this far. See you all in February!

notes.title: Empyrean Swarm is coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
It's been a long journey so far, but I'm thankful for everyone who's been here and everyone who's just joining in!

As stated in the title, Empyrean Swarm is coming to Steam Next Fest, starting February 5th!

Join me live as I show off the game and answer any questions you may have. I can't wait to see you all there!

In the meantime, make sure you Wishlist the game to see any announcements (including the release date). It's so far, yet too close.
